verdict.rationale: Weave provides LLM-judge scorers (hallucination, bias, toxicity, summarization quality) that automatically generate quality assessments of traces, plus automatic signal classification and alerting, and an MCP integration letting agents like Claude Code autonomously read production data and run evaluation/iteration loops. However these are largely evaluation/observability tooling requiring setup rather than spontaneous, native AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced proactively in the UI.
